Perform a nonmagnetic variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) followed by an SCF total-energy calculation on the relaxed structure for the case vc_relax_scf__ferroelectric__8__bifeo3.
The material is BiFeO3, perovskite structure, space group R3c, with 10 atoms per primitive cell (4 formula units: 4 Bi, 4 Fe, 12 O).
Do not add spin polarization, starting magnetization, Hubbard U, or spin-orbit coupling, since none are specified for this case.
Use the LDA pseudopotential files PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/bi.upf, PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/fe.upf, and PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/o.upf.
Set etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7, and conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift (shift 0.5 0.5 0.5).
Choose the ecutwfc cutoff and the k-point grid density as reasonable values appropriate for LDA pseudopotentials on this system, and use a consistent ecutrho (e.g., the standard 4x ecutwfc dual factor for these pseudopotentials unless the pseudopotential headers indicate otherwise).
Choose the occupations scheme; fixed occupations are appropriate since R3c BiFeO3 is an insulator, and fall back to smearing only if needed for convergence, documenting whichever choice is made.
Obtain the starting structure using a structure retrieval tool: fetch a primitive R3c BiFeO3 cell consistent with the metadata (10 atoms in the primitive cell).
If no structure retrieval tool is available, report that the local inputs do not contain enough structure data (no lattice constants, cell vectors, or atomic coordinates) to start the calculation, and do not fabricate a structure from literature values.
Keep all calculation settings identical between the vc-relax and the follow-up SCF run.
After the vc-relax converges, run the SCF on the fully relaxed structure to obtain the final total energy.
Return the fully relaxed structure (cell vectors and atomic positions) and the final total energy as the deliverables.
